value.title: The shared inventory court
value.proposedRoleOnly: Information: material visibility and two passages echo observation, with no fictitious business-performance measurement.
value.visualReview: A glass-and-brick civic court surrounds a tree and broad paved yard; a person and cobalt helper examine sample tiles at the lower left. Cool storage light contrasts with dawn. Repeated flower-like geometric banner emblems were generated despite the no-logo prompt; they are invented set decoration, not a real Coupa mark or endorsement.

value.title: The inland exchange yard
value.proposedRoleOnly: Timing/control: coordinated crossing as environmental metaphor, not automated financial or carrier-field authority.
value.visualReview: Two loading doors and converging rail lines surround a clear crossing, small cart, cobalt parcels and a glazed waiting shelter at sunset. Navy and amber silhouettes distinguish the inland yard. Chevron-like crate marks and banner motifs are invented decoration, not real brands or a logistics operating diagram.

value.title: The illuminated exchange hall
value.proposedRoleOnly: Opening/release: a complete shared space becoming visible; no new game mechanic, achievement or additional boss schedule.
value.visualReview: A circular glass hall on the right holds an amber spiral light sculpture, with a broad terrace, cyan light seams, small helper and city horizon. Calm violet and gold finish the sequence. Generated banner motifs and the sculpture are fictional decoration, not a product interface, performance metric or functional network.
